free_text_notes.physician_note: 72-year-old woman with hypertension, hypothyroidism, admitted 3/17 for right hip hemiarthroplasty after femoral neck fracture. Post-op day 5; pain controlled on oral regimen. A venous thromboembolism risk assessment was completed on admission as per standard protocol. The patient received appropriate preventive measures during the stay. These are no longer needed after discharge.
